# Delivering on the promise of a brighter day for District 10
### Sign up --
Help elect J.R. for Supervisor
## About J.R.
J.R. is a proud resident of District 10 who has served his community as a volunteer and attorney. Since 2010, he has lived in Potrero Hill with his wife, a public librarian, and his son, a San Francisco public school student.
Read J.R.'s Story
## Get Involved.
Take Action.
Volunteer
Sign Up

Voting Information
Donate
Donate Here
## What J.R. Stands for
District 10 was built by strong communities that refused to be ignored by City Hall.
​
These communities organized early on because they knew there were no powerful special interests standing by to lift up their voices – only tireless neighborhood leaders, tenacious small business coalitions and parents who wanted more for their children.
​
J.R. Eppler is running for Supervisor to bring our communities’ voices to City Hall and advocate on behalf of neighborhood priorities. And he understands the importance of focusing on the details and the dollars and cents. Our residents have big plans for our District – J.R. is ready to roll up his sleeves to help them get it done.
J.R. on the Issues

Campaign
We're building a grassroots campaign to fight for every voice in every part of our community.

## Your neighbors, your favorite businesses and your community leaders support J.R.
##### Uzuri Pease-Greene
Executive Director C.A.R.E.*
J.R. has been helping th community, especially in Potrero Hill Public Housing for over a decade. He's been in the fight and will continue to with the community, not against it.
##### Donovan Lacy
Executive Director:
Green Benefit District*
J.R. has championed smart planning initiatives that have delivered more livable, affordable and sustainable neighborhoods for everyone in District 10.
##### Katherine Doumani
Chair: Friends of Dogpatch Hub*
JR is a proven, thoughtful, and effective leader who has demonstrated his commitment to our community for more than a decade.
##### Dontaye Ball
President, Bayview Merchants Association | Small Business Owner*
I've know J.R. for years. He has always focused on what he can do to help our neighborhoods. I support him because he's supported our community.
##### Keith Goldstein
President: Potrero Dogpatch Merchant Association*
Small businesses need champions who advocate for our needs and the success of our communities. J.R. Eppler has always been a leader we can count on to be there for us.
##### Joni Eisen
Community Leader
​
J.R. Eppler stands up for our shared Democratic values. We know he'll keep fighting for our communities and our rights. Like he always has.
##### Jean Bogiages
Community Leader
​
We can count on J.R. Eppler to dive into the details, form coalitions and help us get things done. He uses his knowledge of government to make it work for us on local issues and projects.
##### Edward Hatter
Non-Profit Executive, Community Leader
J.R. understands that we need to keep the promises made to our communities and deliver for District 10.
Positions do not reflect the position of the organization
* Indicates second ranked endorsement
** Indicates 3rd ranked endorsement
